description.value: Bonus to Nature checks made to calm or redirect a spooked mount mid-combat, and your own mount recovers from a frightened or confused condition faster with your help than it would alone.

cinderfall.incomplete: The card states a bonus but gives no numeric value, bonus type, or specific action tag to build a FlatModifier from without inventing one. The 'recovers from frightened or confused faster with your help' clause also has no hook -- no rule element accelerates condition recovery for an ally's mount.
